title: Agentic Development Training: Beginner Recording Now Available — Plus What’s Coming Next
summary: A beginner-level recording on agentic development workflows for Business Central is now available, covering core concepts and AI-assisted automation techniques. The post also outlines intermediate and expert live training sessions scheduled for April and May, with flexible purchasing options including individual recordings and bundle discounts.
key_points: The Beginner recording costs 150 euros and covers core agentic concepts, first automated BC development workflows and getting repeatable value from AI tools
Intermediate (late April to early May) and Expert (mid May) run live on Teams with Q&A, each in three sessions at different times; live attendance is 200 euros per level and includes the recording
Beginner is not required for Intermediate, but it is strongly recommended because each level builds on the previous one
The full series recording bundle costs 350 euros, 100 euros less than buying separately; later recordings are emailed as each level finishes, and no live attendance is included
Recordings are DRM-free with permanent ownership, and tiered team and organisation licences are available

quotes.text: All recordings are DRM-free. No subscriptions, no expiring access. You bought it, you own it.
quotes.why_it_matters: Clarifies the ownership model and total cost of ownership, distinguishing it from subscription-based alternatives
